source.title: U.S. Capitol Preservation Commission (Special and Trust Fund Receipts + Program and Financing)

unit_note: USD millions. U.S. Capitol Preservation Commission trust fund (id 009-8300-0-7-801), combined Receipts + P&F, PDF page 37 (printed 49) left column. Dormant fund: no obligations section at all (no 0900/3xxx rows), receipts only in 2025 actual. 0100 and 5099 print blank (5099 = 1-1 nets to zero, zero-suppressed) so 1140/2000/2101 are standalone; the only multi-source identity is 1930 c1 = 1000 + 1900 = 12+1 = 13. 4190 prints blank in all columns. 5000/5001 investment memos carry the 12/13 par-value corpus. Negatives as printed (2101).
